fusions.name: Scrabbling Kick
fusions.desc: A raking kick that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Muster Stomp
fusions.desc: Stamps in a ring, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Flock on the Road
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 10% for 4 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Beaten Track
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 10%.
